a.title: Microsoft 365 Crawls Back to Life After a 24-Hour Outage

b.lede: Microsoft says a software bug introduced in July caused last week's worldwide Microsoft 365 outage, triggering a cascading failure that left more than 80% of its networking gateway servers unresponsive. [...]
b.title: Microsoft says months-old bug caused global Microsoft 365 outage
